info.title: Aeonic API
info.description: Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (create tokens in Settings). Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. `POST` honors `Idempotency-Key`; `PATCH` honors `If-Match` with the ETag from GET. `GET /api/v1/events` streams server-sent events.

durationMinutes.description: Minutes; defaults to 30 when a start time is given

unblocked.description: True when every blocker is scheduled or done

blocks.description: Ids of tasks directly blocked by this one

days.description: Days to the soonest due date in this task’s downstream tree; negative = overdue

scheduledDependents.description: After unscheduling: dependents still scheduled even though their blocker no longer is

startTime.description: Omit or null for an untimed (all-day style) task

durationMinutes.description: Minutes; defaults to 30 when a start time is given

goal.description: Omit to schedule the whole task; provide to create a scheduled child subtask with this goal

durationMinutes.description: Minutes; defaults to 30 when a start time is given

allOf.description: Next thing to start after now (also given while something is current)

NowItem.description: Happening right now; the soonest-ending one if several overlap

source.description: Host of the ICS link. The full URL is never returned (it often contains a secret).

error.description: Last refresh error; previous data is kept while set

end.description: All-day: exclusive YYYY-MM-DD (as in ICS). Timed: ISO-8601 instant (UTC).

put.summary: Schedule a task on a date (optionally as a timed block)
put.description: Give `startTime` (and optionally `durationMinutes`, default 30) for a timed block; omit it for an untimed task. Fails with 409 (and the blockers) if the task is still blocked.

post.summary: Plan a task on a day (the drag-and-drop flow)
post.description: Without `goal` schedules the whole task. With `goal` creates a new scheduled child subtask.

put.summary: Replace the list of tasks blocking this one

get.summary: Seven-day planner view in one call

post.description: The secret is returned once and cannot be retrieved later.

Deliveries are POSTed as JSON with `X-Aeonic-Event` and `X-Aeonic-Signature: sha256=<hmac of body using the secret>`. Events: task.created|updated|deleted|scheduled|unscheduled|completed, project.created|updated|deleted. Empty `events` = all.

post.summary: Replace all projects and tasks from an export

get.summary: What is happening now, and what is next
get.description: Looks at timed tasks (their wall-clock time is read in `tz`) and timed calendar events. Untimed tasks, all-day events and completed tasks are ignored. `current` is whatever contains the current instant (soonest-ending if several overlap); `next` is the next to start, looking up to 14 days ahead.

get.summary: Events from all enabled calendars, recurrences expanded
get.description: Returns events overlapping the local dates from..to (inclusive, max 400 days). The window is padded by a day or two so clients can clip per day in their own timezone.
